name: mangled-tool-input
about: The provider emits a tool call whose arguments are not valid JSON — a step that ended on `length` with the object half written. Two live turns on 2026-09-12 died this way, which is why `repairToolInput` exists. **Replaying it shows that it still dies**: `repairToolInput` repairs a well-formed object with wrong FIELDS, and truncated bytes are not an object at all, so `repairToolCall` returns null and `ToolLoopAgent` aborts the run — the user gets an error rather than the read the turn had already completed. Filed as KI-2026-09-16-a. A scripted mock cannot produce this input (it is well-formed by construction), which is exactly KI-11's structural point, and this transcript is the harness earning its keep on its first run. The record still names  in  — the model DID ask for it, and the trace is what a reader diagnoses from — while  stays 1 and no proposal exists, which is the pair that says the call never ran.

source.from: the two aborted live turns of 2026-09-12 (repairToolInput's own note)
